messages.text: The toolchain is now fully clean—typecheck, lint, production build, and browser installation all pass—and Geist/Geist Mono are bundled locally. I’m at the final acceptance stage: Chromium will exercise the backed interactions rather than just render screenshots, then I’ll inspect captured storefront, preview, analytics, and mobile states for clipping, overlap, media crop quality, and source fidelity.
